hero.title: A small lab for stubborn software
hero.lede: Named for the original Luddites—not anti-technology, anti-careless technology. We build tools that respect the people who use them.

story.title: Craft over cadence theater
paragraphs: Luddite Labs started as a refusal: refuse bloated stacks, refuse roadmap theater, refuse interfaces that treat users like traffic.
Today we partner with product and ops teams who want software that feels considered—measured, maintainable, and a little bit proud of its joints.

items.title: Fewer parts
items.body: Complexity is a tax. We pay it only when the problem demands it.

items.title: Readable seams
items.body: Boundaries should be obvious to the next engineer at 2 a.m.

items.title: Honest interfaces
items.body: UI and APIs should say what they mean—no dark patterns, no surprise payloads.

items.title: Workshop pace
items.body: Fast where it is cheap, slow where mistakes are expensive.

team.title: The crew
team.lede: A tight group. We stay small on purpose.

members.name: Ada Voss
members.bio: Shapes product systems with a bias toward clarity and durable data models.

members.name: Jonah Reed
members.bio: Designs APIs and pipelines that stay calm when traffic does not.

members.name: Mira Sol
members.bio: Builds interfaces that feel mechanical in the best way—precise, quiet, useful.
